title: GameRules
description: The 'data' object of Data/Gameplay/GameRules.json. Mirrors FLRGameRules (Source/LRGameplay/Public/LRGameRules.h).

CountdownSeconds.description: Length of the countdown before a run, seconds.

ResultsDelaySeconds.description: Time between the crash and the results screen, seconds.

StartSpeedKmh.description: Rolling start speed of a run, km/h.

DefaultVehicleId.description: Vehicle used when the selected one cannot be loaded (Data/Vehicles/<id>.json).

bForgivingArcade.description: Forgiving arcade: impacts consume scrapes before they end the run.

ScrapesAllowed.description: Forgiving arcade: impacts above ScrapeMaxImpactKmh that the run survives.

ScrapeMaxImpactKmh.description: Forgiving arcade: impacts up to this speed are harmless and consume nothing, km/h.

ForgivingFatalImpactKmh.description: Forgiving arcade: impacts from this speed end the run even with scrapes left, km/h. 0 disables the limit.

StartingLaneOffset.description: Start lane relative to the default player lane of the route, lanes (+ = right).

CrashRecoverySeconds.description: Time after a severe impact that did not end the run before the car (free ride) and the engine sound recover, seconds.

FreeRideResetForwardMeters.description: Free ride: how far ahead of the crash the car reappears, meters.

ShoulderAllowanceMeters.description: Smooth steering: how far the side of the player car may go past the outer lane edges, meters. Negative = shoulders allowed up to the barriers.

TitleCruiseKmh.description: Title screen: speed the player car cruises at behind the menu, km/h.

TitleFollowGapMeters.description: Title screen: gap the cruising car keeps to the vehicle ahead in its lane, meters.

NearMissIntensity.description: Intensity of a Close near miss. VeryClose gets twice this value and Razor three times.

NearMissDurationSeconds.description: Length of the near-miss rumble, seconds.

ScrapeIntensity.description: Intensity of a contact that is not severe.

ScrapeDurationSeconds.description: Length of the scrape rumble, seconds.

CrashDurationSeconds.description: Length of the crash rumble, seconds.
